ColonyCouncil.OutsiderTalkDef.heard: {PEOPLE} are no longer at war with {THEN}.

lines.li: [them] The fighting with {THEN} you asked about, it's over.
[us] Truly, that's good news.
[them,their:tribal] The spears are back on the wall, and the drums are quiet.
[them,their:medieval] The levies have gone home to their fields.
[them] For now, anyway.
[us] For now is a good start.
[them] It is, and we mean to keep it that way.
[us] Is it still going with {THEN}?
[them] Still, and no end in sight.
[us] I'm sorry, truly.
[them] Thank you for asking, most don't.
[us] We'll keep you in our thoughts, for what it's worth.
[them] {THEN}, the sickness I told you about, it's passed.
[us] I didn't know, that's a relief.
[them,their:tribal] The healer says the spirits grew bored of us.
[them] We're counting ourselves lucky.
[us] So are we, for you.
[them] I'll tell them at home you asked.
[us] Has {THEN} let up at all?
[them] Not yet, we keep hoping.
[us] Stay well, then.
[them] I'm trying.
[us] If there's anything we can spare, say so.
[us] Last time you said food was short, is it better now?
[them] Better, {THEN} is behind us.
[us] What's it like at home now?
[them,their:tribal] There's meat on the fire again.
[them] There's bread on the table again, and that's enough.
[us] I'm glad.
[us] Is food still short at home?
[them] Still short, but we manage.
[us,colony:plenty] Say so if it gets worse, we've a little put by.
[us] I hope it turns soon.
[us] Did you get through {THEN} all right?
[them,their:tribal] We did, huddled close and telling the long stories.
[them] We did, though some nights it was close.
[us] That's the spirit.
[them] You remember {THEN}, that we talked about?
[us] I do, what came of it?
[them] It's over, it just ended the way these things do.
[us] Then that's one less thing to worry about.
[them] One less, and plenty more where it came from.
[us] Is {THEN} still going on?
[them] Still, would you believe it.
[us] It's been a long while.
[them] Long enough that we hardly talk about anything else.
[us] Then let's talk about something else for a while.
[us] How is {THEN}, any better?
[them] On their feet again, thank you for asking.
[us] That's good to hear.
[them] I'll tell them you asked.
[us] And wish them well from {COLONY}.
[us] How is {THEN}?
[them] {THEN} didn't recover, I'm sorry to say.
[us] I'm so sorry.
[them,their:tribal] We sent them to the spirits with a good fire.
[them] You asked after them, and that means something.
[us] Tell their family we're sorry.
[us] Is {THEN} any better?
[them] Not yet, but still fighting.
[us] Tell them we asked after them.
[them] Remember when you asked about {THEN}?
[us] I do, why?
[them] {NOW} leads us now.
[us] Things change fast out there.
[them] Faster than any of us would like.
[us] What became of {THEN} you told me about?
[them] Gone, and nobody misses it.
[us] Good riddance, then.
[us] Was the road kinder this time?
[them,rain|snow|storm] About as kind as the weather, so no.
[them,!rain,!snow,!storm] A little, thank you for asking.
[us] You remember the last time, then.
[them] My feet remember it better than I do.
[us] Last time you were bringing in the harvest at home.
[them,town:short:food] What there was of it, and it's nearly gone.
[them,!town:short:food] It's in, and the stores are full enough.
[us] Good, it's a long year otherwise.
[them] It is, and the winter's the long part.
[us] Then here's to an easy one.
[them] Last time you'd just brought a harvest in, did it hold?
[us,colony:hungry] Not as well as we'd hoped.
[us,!colony:hungry] Well enough, thank you for asking.
[them,colony:hungry] That's a shame, it happens to everyone.
[them,!colony:hungry] Good, then you'll eat well this year.
[us] We'll see how the next one goes.
[them] It's always the next one, isn't it?
[them] Any more trouble since that raid you told me about?
[us,colony:raid] More, I'm afraid, and not long ago.
[us,!colony:raid] Not since, touch wood.
[them,colony:raid] I'm sorry to hear it.
[them,!colony:raid] Long may it stay quiet.
[us,colony:raid] We'll be ready for the next one.
[us,!colony:raid] We'll be ready if it comes.
[them] I believe it.
[us] How is {THEN}?
[them] Well, the last I saw, thank you.
[us] You remembered I asked.
[them] And you remembered the name, that's rarer.
[us] Names are easy when someone talks about their family the way you do.
[them] I've been thinking about what you said, about {OURFAITH}.
[us] And?
[them,them:abrasive] And you're still wrong, but you argue well.
[them,!them:abrasive] And I'm still thinking, that's all.
[us] That's all I'd ask.
[them] Then come and argue with me again next time.
